title.narrative: Blended Finance for Rapid Transit Project

description.narrative: MCC's Board voted to terminate this program in August 2025. Kenya Urban Mobility and Growth Threshold Program - Blended Finance for Rapid Transit Project: The Blended Finance for BRT Project aims to catalyze private financing to support the acquisition of electric (or other low emission) buses to operate one or more lines of the bus rapid transit (BRT) system, currently being prepared for the Nairobi metropolitan area. The project aims to facilitate the timely operation of BRT lines and contribute to the Government of Kenya�s goals of reducing greenhouse gas emissions related to urban transportation.

condition.narrative: Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for the Blended Finance for BRT Project, the Parties must agree on, and MCC provide written approval for, either the Bus Leasing Option or such other blended finance opportunities developed in accordance with Annex I.A.4.

Before the ninth Disbursement of Grant funding for the Blended Finance for BRT Project, the Accountable Entity must produce a written Project design with a project logic diagram, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, and establish an indicator to measure the Project Objective, including a definition, baseline, and target, which information shall be incorporated into an approved M&E Plan in form and substance satisfactory to MCC.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
